imaginations.title: The notary who cannot read
imaginations.image_or_idea: A notary stamps every document as genuine, and everyone treats the stamp as proof the contents are true.
imaginations.possible_value: Separates provenance from truth in a memorable image
imaginations.test_question: Does a verified signature ever raise the probability of a claim's accuracy beyond base rate?

imaginations.title: The colour that only exists while you look
imaginations.image_or_idea: A circle painted in a pigment that decays from green to blue at a fixed rate, so the 'true' colour depends on when you ask. Two observers, both honest, both correct, both disagreeing forever.
imaginations.possible_value: Makes 'which colour' a measurement question rather than a taste question
imaginations.test_question: Does recording the observation time eliminate the disagreement, or merely relocate it?

self_observation.text: The explicit state supports that I revised a belief at tick 2 on verified contrary evidence, and that the affect path is ablated so no signal guided either decision. Surprise worth noting: I have now been asked twice for a binary verdict on material that does not support one, and both times the honest answer was a refusal to discriminate.
